publication_boundaries: No future source check, outcome value, trend, causal conclusion, score, rank, owner disposition, translation approval, repository publication, hosted deployment, public launch, or v1 promotion is created by this accelerated build.

Historical /review routes remain immutable editions; /reference/ provides a stable reader entry point without rewriting prior receipts.
